component.name: NewScid
component.summary: Modern Chess Information Database (Scid vs. PC Rewrite)

description.p: NewScid is a fresh, database-compatible rewrite of Scid vs. PC featuring a modern, responsive user interface powered by Wails v2 (Go backend) and Vue 3 (TypeScript + Vite).

ul.li: Native binary compatibility with Scid .si4, .sn4, and .sg4 databases
Lightning fast index search and Huffman/coordinate game decompression
Comprehensive PGN parsing and export with NAGs, commentary, and variations
Opening Tree Explorer with live move statistics and candidate scoring
Real-time UCI chess engine analysis with evaluation curve graphs and blunder detection
Opening Repertoire Trainer with spaced-repetition move recall
Tactics challenge ladder and automated database puzzle miner
Multiple chessboard themes and 17 vector piece sets

description.p: Initial release of NewScid with full Scid database support and modern UI.
